Both workers' raised hands are lumpy thumbs-up fists whose fingers are swollen blobs with no knuckles.

The dog in the boat is a broad-headed pit-bull type with both ears folded and a white blaze up its forehead, not the slim street dog with one folded ear.
defects.where: dog's head, centre-left of the boat

refuted.what: Usman has two large upright ears.
